newsitem.title: IRAN: Second candidate to run in Iran polls - paper.
newsitem.headline: Second candidate to run in Iran polls - paper.

text.p: A former Iranian minister of culture and Islamic guidance will soon announce his candidacy in the country's June 11 presidential elections, the English-language Iran News daily reported on Tuesday.

Mohammad Khatami would join Iranian parliamentary speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, so far the only declared candidate in the election to replace the country's current President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani who has served two four-year terms.
"Khatami has made up his mind and will be in the race without any doubt...Mr Khatami will file his nomination papers as an independent candidate," Iran News quoted an informed source as saying.
Khatami heads a political faction within the leftist Majma-e Rouhanioun-e-Mobarez (MRM) party.
Under Iran's constitution the president is allowed to serve only two consecutive terms.
